content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure of the `TestAuthFilterAuthOozieClient` test cases after the changes made in OOZIE-1917, which involved modifications to the authentication mechanism. Specifically, the test cases were relying on system properties to configure authentication settings, but the patch updated the tests to use a `Configuration` object instead. This change was necessary to ensure that the tests correctly set the authentication properties in a way that aligns with the new implementation, which likely required a more structured configuration approach rather than relying on system properties.
